svg.title: Training and inference workflow with prototype update illustration
svg.desc: Two-row diagram. Top row inventory: Train panel with input image stack, arrow to encoder blocks, arrow to projector, arrow to prototype memory P_train, and a right CCE-M clustering panel feeding back with a left arrow. Bottom row inventory: Inference panel with stream data thumbnails, arrow to encoder updated by L_TTA, projector, embeddings, and a prototype update subpanel showing old P_inference, update loop, and new P_new. Symmetry/equipartition: block and matrix rows use horizontal row alignment and repeated cell partitions; stream thumbnails use a 2x2 grid; prototype panels use stacked rectangular matrices.
